label: SmartRecruiters
terms_note: Posting API: public company postings + public POST candidates/apply per posting (no key). Includes SmartRecruiters' own job board (jobs.smartrecruiters.com).

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial** (public company postings; apply + status need a company / partner token).
auth: 1. Public postings: no credential (OpenAPI security `{}`), or an API key / OAuth client-credentials token with `internal_postings_read` for internal postings.
2. Apply: `X-SmartToken` company API key or OAuth scope `candidate_applications_manage`; status: `candidate_view_application_status_read`. Both are customer / partner credentials.

endpoints.notes: jobAd sections, location, department, industry, function, experienceLevel, typeOfEmployment, applyUrl, postingUrl, releasedDate
questions with required flags, consent model

firstName*, lastName*, email*, answers (required screening questions; INPUT_TEXT ≤4 kB), consentDecisions {SINGLE} or {SMART_RECRUIT, SMART_CRM, SMART_MESSAGE_SMS, SMART_MESSAGE_WHATSAPP}, attachments (base64), internal, createJoinLink → smartrJoinUrl
NEW, IN_REVIEW, INTERVIEW, OFFERED, HIRED, ARCHIVED (+ REJECTED, WITHDRAWN_BY_APPLICANT, TRANSFERRED, DELETED_BY_COMPANY)

reference.limits: 10 requests/second on most endpoints, 2 requests/second on a listed subset, plus a concurrency limiter; `429` on excess. - Public postings need no credential and are meant for company career sites; the operation on `/postings/{uuid}/candidates` is 'done on behalf of a candidate' but authenticated with the company's or a partner's credential. - No public unauthenticated apply endpoint is in the current docs, so candidate-side apply → assist (applyUrl). Registry `api.apply: true` / 'no key' contradicted.
mcp_sdk: https://developers.smartrecruiters.com/llms.txt (markdown + OpenAPI index). No official MCP server found.

config_fields.name: company_identifier
config_fields.help: The company identifier as it appears at the end of its SmartRecruiters career site, e.g. 'smartrecruiters' in https://careers.smartrecruiters.com/smartrecruiters.

search.note: Public Posting API for ONE company (config company_identifier): GET /v1/companies/{companyIdentifier}/postings 'Lists active postings published by given company' without credentials (public postings only). q is the 'full-text search query based on a job title, location'; location is sent as the exact city filter and country as the country-code filter; limit ('max value is 100') and offset page the results (total = totalFound). id is the posting id (use it with get_posting, which adds the job-ad text and URLs). List rows carry no description or URL; department, function, typeOfEmployment, experienceLevel, location.remote/hybrid, uuid and customField[] are in raw.

get_posting.note: GET /v1/companies/{companyIdentifier}/postings/{postingId} (posting id or uuid). description is the job-ad 'Job Description' section as HTML; companyDescription, qualifications and additionalInformation sections, applyUrl and referralUrl are in raw.

not_offered.me: The public Posting API needs no credentials and has no account endpoint.
not_offered.apply: The Application API (https://developers.smartrecruiters.com/docs/application-api) 'enables our customers and partners' to submit applications: 'All endpoints are protected' (customer API key or OAuth scope candidate_applications_manage) and the flow must present the posting's screening/diversity questions and privacy policies, which this vocabulary cannot carry; candidates apply at the posting's applyUrl.
not_offered.list_messages: The Posting API has no messaging endpoints.

live_check.notes: verified against the public company BoschGroup; all read tools answered, schema-valid, pagination advances
